scopes.why: Read the current Auth.js session via GET {basePath}/session (Auth.js's own cookie-authenticated session endpoint) to expose the signed-in user via useAuth().
Sign the user out via Auth.js's own CSRF-protected signout flow (GET {basePath}/csrf then POST {basePath}/signout) when the app calls useAuth().signOut().

Verify the current request's Auth.js session server-side via an app-supplied sessionResolver (bridging the app's own auth()), applying fail-closed presence+expiry validation before any protected server route trusts the caller.
